authorization.question_verbatim: 另外请明确确认两项验收调整是否都同意：① U27/U28 改测兼容回复无副作用、dangerous 不越权；② baseline 副本先完成原始 bytes/modes 精确恢复校验，再做权限准备并验证同一旧 run 延续。这两项获准后可以继续推进

meaning: Database restoration before preparation means exact restored database file bytes/modes, not opening SQLite before preparation. SQLite consistency/schema/same-run/owner/key checks occur after mode-only preparation, so WAL recovery cannot mutate the exact-restore proof before it is sealed.
required_order: extract existing authorized archive into a fresh disposable copy
persist durable exact original bytes and modes verification
recheck the same exact restored hashes immediately before preparation
prepare only copied baseline filesystem modes without changing file content
open SQLite and verify schema7, original same run, owner and key binding
start the exact schema7 baseline and verify prepared continuation of that same old run
